deleteDialog.title: Delete this entry?
deleteDialog.description: This permanently removes the entry from your journal. This action cannot be undone.
deleteDialog.descriptionWithUnsavedChanges: This permanently removes the entry and its unsaved changes. This action cannot be undone.

unsavedDialog.title: Discard unsaved changes?
unsavedDialog.description: Continuing will permanently discard the changes you have not saved.
